fearGreed.method: Equal-weight average of five game scores. Each game score is a weighted mix of trend momentum (30%), headline sentiment (25%), 14-day news volume (20%), and monthly category price momentum (25%). Trend uses Google Trends worldwide interest (five queries compared on one 0–100 scale) when available, otherwise Wikipedia pageviews (labeled). Scores are computed, never invented.

pokemon.t: SNKRDUNK (JP) (15 Nov 2026): Japanese set Hadow Seeker releases 27 Nov, headlined by Mega Lucario Z ex, with Mega Garchomp Z ex and Mega Absol Z ex also confirmed. Pre-order and lottery roundup updated today.
SNKRDUNK (JP) (15 Nov): 30th Celebration hit ranking — Mew R/RGB about ¥800,000 market, ¥900,000 buyback at SNKRDUNK Akihabara (15 Nov read). Lugia and Charizard reprints follow.
SNKRDUNK (JP) (15 Nov): MEGA special deck set (Mega Feraligatr / Dragonite / Gengar) market and card list, plus a Storm Emeralda reprint restock roundup, both updated today.
Hot set: Mega Evolution — Delta Reign, out Nov 6. Headliner Mega Rayquaza ex.
Chase: Mega Rayquaza ex SIR 138/103 $296.14 (Nov 13, down from $397.94 at launch). Gold Mega Hyper Rare 141/103 $222.23 on Nov 14 (DexHaul), −36% from $349.35 on Nov 6.
Sealed: Delta Reign booster box $193.62 TCGPlayer market Nov 13, down from $222.95 at launch. ETB $82.66, down from $103.18.
Next: a new English set was unveiled for January 2027, before Flowing Fists (ScreenRant, Nov 13).
Category index −8% over the past month (GempireCards, Nov 14).

onepiece.t: SNKRDUNK (JP) (15 Nov 2026): Japanese OP-18 The Dominance of God pre-order and lottery roundup, updated today.
SNKRDUNK (JP): Heroines Edition vol.2 hit-card guide is still on their popular-articles list.
Next set: OP-18 The Dominance of God, English release Nov 20. Water Seven + Holy Knights of God; Saint Gunko and Saint Shamrock debut.

Chase (pre-order ask, not sales): Saint Shamrock OP18-119 Amano alt listed $499.99 on Nov 13 (was $1,999.99 on Nov 5, no sale yet). Nico Robin super alt and Saint Gunko leader alt are the other headliners.
Sealed: OP-18 box pre-orders ~$218.79–$219.24 (Nov 13), down 21% from $277.62 on Nov 5. MSRP is $119.76 (24 × $4.99).
Still cooling: Heroines Edition Vol. 2 Nami (OP01-016) SP $467.79 sale-derived, −52.6% over 7 days (TCG Meta, Nov 8).

mtg.t: Live set: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek — Arena Nov 10, tabletop Nov 13, same weekend as MagicCon: Atlanta and World Championship 32.
Live Scryfall USD (special treatments included, fetched this snapshot): H.M.S. Bounty, Unlikely Timeship $200; Will Riker, First in the Field $123.31; Dathon, His Heart Open $103.98.
Media: Netflix showed first looks at Planeswalker, a Magic animated series slated for 2027 (The Verge and others, Nov 14).
Other: a signed Star Trek card was pulled (reports Nov 14). Early TCG Meta presale reads on Nov 8 had already shown a steep cooldown on some Commander prints.
Category index +1% over the past month (GempireCards, Nov 14).

lorcana.t: Ban: My Adventure Book was banned in Core Constructed on Nov 3. Sale-derived price $9.00 raw NM on Nov 4, up 28.6% over 7 days — unusual for a banned card.
Hot set: Hyperia City (Set 14), last Lorcana release of 2026 (Oct 23), including Coco glimmers. Héctor Rivera — Worldwide Sensation (Enchanted) 232/204 $49.63, −2.5%.
Next: Set 15 is confirmed for early 2027; Ravensburger has not locked a date. Collector Boosters with serialized cards now ship with every new release.
Play: Disney Lorcana Challenge in London, Nov 13–15. Category index −4% over the past month.

yugioh.t: Hot set: Magnificent Maestros launched Nov 12 — 18 reimagined maestro cards (Blue-Eyes, Cyber End Dragon and more), extra extended-art and Grand Master Rares.
The tape: Yu-Gi-Oh! category index +16% over the past month, +47% over 3 months, +140% over the past year, while Pokémon was −8% on the month (GempireCards, Nov 14).
Next: Glorious Victors arrives in December with new strategies and premium rarities (ICv2, Nov 13).
Format: the Perfectron Hydradrive Dragon change from the Oct 19 Forbidden & Limited list took effect Nov 11.
SNKRDUNK (JP) (31 Oct 2026): Immortal Phoenix launch-day hit-card opening prices (Japanese OCG booster, out 31 Oct).
